name: Pit
overview: The biblical concept of the pit encompasses both literal and figurative meanings, illustrating danger, judgment, and deliverance. Benaiah's courageous act of slaying a lion in the midst of a pit (2 Samuel 23:20) highlights God's enabling power in perilous situations. Figuratively, the pit represents traps of wickedness and downfall, as seen in Psalms 7:15-16 and Psalms 57:6, where evildoers fall into their own snares. Yet, God's salvation is powerfully portrayed in Psalms 40:2, where He lifts the psalmist out of a horrible pit onto solid ground, affirming His deliverance from death and corruption (Psalms 16:10).
